Search USAspending by awarding agency and return recent spend, award count, top vendors, top categories, and a date-window summary.

Usage:
  govspend-pp-cli agency <name-or-abbreviation> [flags]

Examples:
  govspend-pp-cli agency NASA --since 30d --limit 2 --agent

Flags:
      --agent           Emit compact agent-friendly JSON output
      --dry-run         Print the read-only request without calling the source API
      --from string     Start date in YYYY-MM-DD
  -h, --help            help for agency
      --json            Emit JSON output
      --limit int       Maximum awards to return (default 10)
      --select string   Select comma-separated top-level JSON fields
      --since string    Relative lookback window such as 30d, 12m, or 1y (default "365d")
      --to string       End date in YYYY-MM-DD

Search public grant opportunities by query, agency, category, status, and date window when the Grants.gov source is available.

Examples:

Flags:
      --agency string     Grants.gov agency code or name
      --agent             Emit compact agent-friendly JSON output
      --category string   Funding category code
      --dry-run           Print the read-only request without calling the source API
  -h, --help              help for grants
      --json              Emit JSON output
      --limit int         Maximum opportunities to return (default 10)
      --query string      Keyword search text
      --select string     Select comma-separated top-level JSON fields
      --status string     Opportunity status list, such as posted or forecasted|posted (default "forecasted|posted")

Search SAM.gov active or recent opportunities by query, NAICS, organization, state, and posted date window when GOVSPEND_SAM_API_KEY is configured.

Usage:
  govspend-pp-cli opportunities [flags]

Examples:
  govspend-pp-cli opportunities --query cybersecurity --posted-from 05/01/2026 --posted-to 05/31/2026 --dry-run --agent

Flags:
      --agent                 Emit compact agent-friendly JSON output
      --dry-run               Print the read-only request without calling the source API
  -h, --help                  help for opportunities
      --json                  Emit JSON output
      --limit int             Maximum opportunities to return (default 10)
      --naics string          NAICS code
      --organization string   Organization name
      --posted-from string    Posted from date in MM/DD/YYYY
      --posted-to string      Posted to date in MM/DD/YYYY
      --query string          Search text for opportunity title
      --select string         Select comma-separated top-level JSON fields
      --state string          Place of performance state
      --type string           SAM.gov procurement type code such as o, k, p, r, or a

Search USAspending award data for a recipient/vendor and return a compact profile: total obligations, award count, top agencies, top NAICS/PSC categories, recent awards, source URL, and freshness notes.

Usage:

Examples:
  govspend-pp-cli vendor "Palantir" --since 30d --limit 2 --agent

Flags:

  -h, --help            help for vendor
